experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r1-prefix-v1 target. One run of steps 1 to 3 of the proof.md algorithm per organizer seed, each returning a 23-byte message and a 24-byte message. Every trial is returned. The program does not evaluate the target hash; the organizer recomputes both digests.
experiments.hypothesis: Every trial returns two distinct messages with equal complete 256-bit digests, as the identity in proof.md Sections 2 and 4 predicts for every coin value. The run checks that identity on concrete inputs; it is not evidence of attack cost, and no probability estimate is drawn from the seed expansion.
